residual_risks: This G2 spike qualifies the selected Kafka delivery mechanism but is not BA or final runtime-conformance evidence.
The foundation compose stack intentionally uses tmpfs and cannot itself provide restart durability; qualifying evidence used an isolated persistent volume with the identical pinned Kafka image.
Exactly-once visible effects depend on the governed consumer retaining the demonstrated event-id deduplication contract.
Server-side main protection remains EXTERNAL_CONTROL_PENDING and compensating controls are not equivalent.
rollback: Revert the isolated spike commits; the campaign removes its exact generated container, topic, and named volume and changes no runtime migration or approved component selection.
